read.thesis: Revenue up 48% to $23.0B with FY26 guidance raised to $85-87B, but management flagged one-time rebate benefits and underlying U.S. price down 9%, so the beat is partly price-quality noise.

capex.quote: Committed an additional $4.5 billion to Indiana manufacturing sites and opened a dedicated genetic medicine facility in Lebanon, Indiana.

triggers.label: Underlying U.S. price -9%
triggers.quote: Excluding these adjustments, U.S. price declined by 9%.

triggers.label: Revenue +48% to $23.0B
triggers.quote: Revenue -- $23.0 billion, a 48% increase reflecting higher volume from Zepbound and Mounjaro.

triggers.label: FY26 revenue guide raised to $85-87B
triggers.quote: We now expect full-year revenue to be between $85 billion and $87 billion.

triggers.label: Extra $4.5B Indiana manufacturing
triggers.quote: Committed an additional $4.5 billion to Indiana manufacturing sites

guidance.quote: We now expect full-year revenue to be between $85 billion and $87 billion.
we now expect our non-GAAP performance margin to be between 49% and 50.5%
We now expect non-GAAP earnings per share of $35.50 to $36.50
plan to submit in the U.S. in quarter 1 2027 under the BLA pathway.

guidance.metric: Foundayo global rollout in major markets
guidance.quote: we expect a global rollout in all major markets in 2027.

red_flags.label: One-time rebate benefit flatters price
red_flags.quote: In Q2, U.S. price benefited from a change to estimates for rebates and discounts.

red_flags.label: Foundayo launch slower than expected
red_flags.quote: In the U.S., the launch curve has been somewhat slower than anticipated.

red_flags.label: Generic semaglutide competition ex-US
red_flags.quote: we continue to see TRx growth for Mounjaro even after the launch of generic semaglutide.

evasions.quote: We'll stick with the same view here.
we do need to gather a little bit more on the CMC side.
